title: monitor.json
description: monitor.json is how a monitor runs, and what its fix may do, in .kiln/monitors/<name>/monitor.json. A monitor with a gauge names atLeast or atMost, and every other key is optional. The keys recheck, mustAccept and writesTests apply to a fix. kiln refuses each of them in a monitor with no command and no agent.md, since that monitor makes no fix.

$schema.description: $schema is the path of the JSON Schema that an editor checks this file against: "../../monitor.schema.json". kiln init writes that schema to .kiln/. kiln ignores this key.

hours.description: hours is the number of whole hours between runs of the monitor, from 0 to 65535, such as 1. With 0, every kiln monitor run runs the monitor. Absent, it is 24.

recheck.description: recheck says whether the gate of the monitor's fix runs the monitor's check or gauge again. Absent or true, the gate runs it, and fails while it still finds the problem. Set it false when no fix clears the problem until the fix is deployed. kiln refuses recheck in a monitor with no command and no agent.md.

mustAccept.description: mustAccept, when true, keeps each fix that passes on its branch until the developer runs kiln accept on it. Absent or false, a fix that passes lands on main. kiln refuses mustAccept in a monitor with no command and no agent.md.

writesTests.description: writesTests, when true, lets a fix write the acceptance tests of every spec. Those are the files under the part of each acceptance path before {spec}, such as uat/ for "uat/{spec}/". Absent or false, a fix writes nothing there. kiln then refuses the monitor while kiln.json's acceptanceTests is absent, or names a path that starts with {spec}. kiln refuses writesTests in a monitor with no command and no agent.md.

atLeast.description: atLeast is the lowest reading of the monitor's gauge that needs no fix, such as 80. A reading below it starts a fix. In a monitor with no command and no agent.md, such a reading notifies the developer instead. A monitor with a gauge names atLeast or atMost, never both. kiln refuses atLeast in a monitor with no gauge.

atMost.description: atMost is the highest reading of the monitor's gauge that needs no fix, such as 0. A reading above it starts a fix. In a monitor with no command and no agent.md, such a reading notifies the developer instead. A monitor with a gauge names atLeast or atMost, never both. kiln refuses atMost in a monitor with no gauge.
